project.summary: Runtime-switchable model output styles with Claude Code outputStyles parity: a /style command, per-session persistence, and a web picker.

release.compatibility: @deepseek-ai/dsh 0.1.0-rc.6 (real bundle install via dsh plugin add and profile boot verified on Windows, 2026-08-15)
release.changelog: Fix bundle install on rc.6 (storage row config); add dsh.client and dshWorkshop manifests. Full list in CHANGELOG.md.

management.label: dsh plugin --profile <name> add dsh-output-styles
management.instructions: Install from npm with `dsh plugin --profile <name> add dsh-output-styles`; the bundle patch composes the storage rows plus the plugin row. Web profiles can add the picker client row `- id: output-styles-client / name: dsh-output-styles/client`.

declarations.permissions: fs:read (style library files), fs:watch (style directories), storage:read/storage:write (output_style selection domain), settings:read (output-style namespace); no network access.
declarations.testing: 93 vitest unit/integration tests plus GitHub Actions CI (typecheck, tests, self-contained check, build on Node 22 and 24); real rc.6 bundle install and profile boot verified on Windows 2026-08-15.

capability.expected: the command replies 'switched to concise' and the next assembled system prompt contains the concise style body
